instruction:
The tables in the document are missing borders, and some tables are also missing headings. Requirements:
1. Add all missing borders to every table in the document.
2. Align the text in vertically adjacent cells of the table shown in the image.
3. At the locations circled in red in the image, add, from left to right in order, “Start Time,” “Professional and Technical Personnel Category,” “Guidance Content,” and “Guidance Status,” with one heading per cell and each heading corresponding to its specific content.
